name: What plumbing changes are involved in a bathtub remodel?

mainEntity.name: What plumbing changes are involved in a bathtub remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathtub remodel often involves assessing and potentially upgrading existing plumbing. This can include relocating drain lines, adjusting water supply pipes for a new tub or shower configuration, and ensuring proper venting. We also check the condition of shut-off valves and make recommendations for new fixtures like faucets and showerheads. If you're converting from a tub to a shower, or vice-versa, significant pipe adjustments might be necessary to accommodate different fixture heights and drainage requirements, ensuring everything meets local plumbing codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing changes can include relocating drain lines, adjusting water supply pipes, and upgrading fixtures to suit the new bathtub or shower configuration.
